description: Saskatoon police report missing persons decreased for two consecutive years.
Youth under 18 account for 69% of all missing person reports.
Addictions, mental health, and poverty are identified risk factors.

chips.text: Sergeant Moser explained the Missing Youth Sask app reduces unnecessary reports from care homes.
Why more young girls than boys are on the missing list remains unknown.

description: Saskatoon Police made significant progress on 36 initiatives.
Launched intimate partner violence response team in 2025.

chips.text: Commissioner Jeffries praised the intimate partner violence response team.
Intimate partner violence victims face disproportionately high rates in Saskatchewan.

description: Transfers $2.95 million to Capital Equipment Reserve.
Transfers $1.07 million to Fiscal Stabilization Reserve.

chips.text: $1.1M to the SPS Fiscal Stabilization Reserve
SPS capital and operating reserves strengthened.
Staff committed to integrating long-term savings into future budgets.

description: Board of Police Commissioners meeting moved to April 23, 2026.
Police Commissioners' 2025 Strategic Plan Status Report posted online.
Board will not bid to host 2027 CAPG conference.

chips.text: Hosting the conference places significant resource pressure on the police service and board.
Unclear if a full-time staff position would be required to support the conference.
Riversdale Business Improvement District supported Saskatoon's bid to host the conference.
